# Clicksnads

> Clicksnads (also written Clicks&Ads) is a digital marketing agency and website
> development company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It builds custom
> websites and runs digital marketing campaigns for small and mid-sized
> businesses in India and internationally.

## What Clicksnads does
- Website development: custom-coded, SEO-ready websites (React/Vue/Next.js), no page builders
- Website redesign: audits and relaunches of underperforming existing sites
- SEO and AI search optimisation (schema markup, technical SEO, Core Web Vitals)
- Performance marketing: Google Ads and Meta Ads management, PPC
- Social media management: content calendars, copywriting, community management
- Logo and brand identity design
- Photography and content production (product photography, reels, video)
- UI/UX design and prototyping

## Where
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Works with clients across India and internationally
(remote-friendly — India, UAE, Australia, UK, US clients to date).

## Pricing (starting points)
- Logo design: from ₹8,000
- Landing pages: from ₹15,000
- Full websites: from ₹25,000
- Brand + web packages: from ₹40,000
- Monthly maintenance/support retainers: from ₹5,000/month
